plugin.name: RetreatFnSucks
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: re/rw/rn/rs/ru/rd retreat in one direction and keep retrying it on every failure

muclient.script:
-- ===================================================================== -- Colours (user's standard theme) -- x099 brackets / x045 name / W message / x048 highlight -- ===================================================================== local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" -- x099 local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" -- x045 local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" -- W local CLR_HI = "#00FF87" -- x048
local TAG = "RetreatFnSucks"
local function echo (msg) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg) end
-- [RetreatFnSucks] <msg><HI hi><tail> local function echoHi (msg, hi, tail) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg, CLR_HI, "", hi, CLR_MSG, "", tail or "") end
local function helpLine (left, right) ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-10s", left), CLR_MSG, "", right) end
-- ===================================================================== -- Configuration -- ===================================================================== local COMBAT_STATE = 8 -- char.status "state": fighting
-- An attempt only stays live while the MUD is still answering us. Each fail -- line refreshes it; if nothing happens for this long we assume the fight is -- long over and stop retrying on a stale direction. local STALE_SECS = 60
-- How many directions can be stacked up: the leg we are doing now plus two -- behind it. Picking one more than this cancels the lot. local QUEUE_MAX = 3
-- After a retreat lands we wait for the next char.status to say whether the -- mob in the new room has us fighting again. It arrives with the next prompt; -- this is only a fail-safe in case one never does. local VERDICT_SECS = 5
-- Combat breaking ends the queue - but the room change for the retreat that -- broke it can reach us a moment later than the status that reports it, so -- give the move this long to show up before dropping everything. local GRACE_SECS = 2
-- A direction armed while nothing is fighting us waits this long for a fight -- to start before it is dropped. local ARM_SECS = 20
local DIRS = { e = "east", w = "west", n = "north", s = "south", u = "up", d = "down", }
-- ===================================================================== -- State -- ===================================================================== local gEnabled = true -- reton / retoff / ret local gSilent = false -- retsilent: hide the per-retry "Retreat failed" line local gQueue = {} -- stacked directions; [1] is the one we are doing now local gWaiting = false -- retreat landed; [1] is held until the next -- char.status says whether we are still fighting local gLast = 0 -- os.time () of the last retreat we sent local gTries = 0 -- retreats sent for gQueue[1] local gVnum = nil -- last room.info vnum seen local gZone = nil -- last room.info zone (area) seen local gState = nil -- last char.status "state" seen (nil = not seen yet) local gEndedAt = nil -- os.time () the fight ended without us moving local gWalked = false -- the leg in flight is a plain walk, not a retreat local gLegSent = false -- a leg is out there waiting to land; whichever -- signal reports it first advances the queue once local gGmcp = 0 -- room.info / char.status messages seen (retdebug) local gFought = false -- we have actually been in combat on this chain
-- Everything is off: moved on, fight over, cancelled, or plugin off. local function clearQueue () gQueue = {} gWaiting = false gTries = 0 gLast = 0 gEndedAt = nil gWalked = false gLegSent = false gFought = false end
-- Drop the queue once it can no longer mean anything. Called before we read -- it, so no timer is needed: char.status arrives with the prompt constantly. local function sweep () if #gQueue == 0 then return end local now = os.time () if now - gLast > STALE_SECS then clearQueue () return end -- Armed while nothing was fighting us and nothing ever started: let it go -- fairly quickly, so a direction typed minutes ago cannot jump into a -- fight it was never meant for. if not gFought and now - gLast > ARM_SECS then clearQueue () return end if gWaiting then -- No verdict ever arrived; assume the fight is over. if now - gLast > VERDICT_SECS then clearQueue () end elseif gEndedAt and now - gEndedAt > GRACE_SECS then -- The fight ended and we never moved: the retreat is moot. clearQueue () end end
local function queueLive () sweep () return #gQueue > 0 end
-- Out of combat the aliases are plain shortcuts: the retreat still goes to -- the MUD, but no attempt is armed - there is nothing to retry, and nothing -- to conflict with the next direction you pick in a real fight. gState is -- nil only before the first char.status of the session. local function inCombat () return gState == nil or gState == COMBAT_STATE end
local function sendRetreat () gTries = gTries + 1 gWaiting = false gWalked = false gLegSent = true gLast = os.time () Send ("retreat " .. gQueue[1]) end
-- Nothing is on us, so there is nothing to retreat from: walk this leg -- instead. It stays at the front of the queue until the room change says it -- landed, exactly like a retreat does. local function walkNext () gWaiting = false gWalked = true gLegSent = true gEndedAt = nil gTries = 0 gLast = os.time () local dir = gQueue[1] Send (dir) if not gSilent then echoHi ("Nothing on us - walking ", dir, " instead.") end end
-- The retreat worked. Drop it off the front and hold whatever was stacked -- behind it until the next char.status: still fighting (the mob in the new -- room is on us) means we retreat again, an empty room means we walk it. -- -- We wait for that fresh reading rather than trusting the last char.status we -- saw, because room.info can reach us before the status that reports the -- fight ending - acting on the stale "still fighting" would fire a retreat -- into an empty room. char.status carries enemypct, so it is re-sent every -- round of a fight: the wait is a prompt, not a pause. local function advanceQueue () -- We already know the room is clear if combat had broken before this move -- arrived, or if the leg that just landed was a walk and nothing has -- engaged us since - no need to wait for a verdict in either case. local landedClear = gEndedAt ~= nil or (gWalked and gState ~= COMBAT_STATE)
table.remove (gQueue, 1) gTries = 0 gEndedAt = nil gLegSent = false
if #gQueue == 0 then clearQueue () return end
if landedClear then walkNext () return end
gWaiting = true gLast = os.time () end
-- ===================================================================== -- Alias callbacks -- =====================================================================
-- re / rw / rn / rs / ru / rd function RetreatDir (letter) local dir = DIRS[string.lower (letter or "")] if not dir then return end
-- A queued direction still counts as live while it waits for the next -- fight, so pick the queue up before deciding what this keypress means. local live = queueLive ()
-- Plugin off: send it and nothing else. -- -- We arm the retry even when GMCP says we are not fighting. A mob you walk -- in on engages a moment AFTER the room arrives, so "not fighting" at the -- instant you hit the key is routine - refusing to arm there is what left a -- failed retreat sitting with nothing to retry it. if not gEnabled then clearQueue () Send ("retreat " .. dir) return end
-- The stack is full and here comes one more: cancel the lot. if #gQueue >= QUEUE_MAX then clearQueue () echo ("Conflicting Messages: Make Up Your Mind.") return end
table.insert (gQueue, dir)
-- Already fighting when the chain starts: that counts, so the "the fight -- ended and we never moved" cleanup still applies to it. if gState == COMBAT_STATE then gFought = true end
if #gQueue == 1 then gTries = 0 sendRetreat () elseif not gSilent then echoHi ("Queued: ", dir, " once the current retreat lands.") end end
function RetreatSetOn (on) gEnabled = on and true or false if not gEnabled then clearQueue () end SetVariable ("enabled", gEnabled and "1" or "0") if gEnabled then echoHi ("Auto-retry is ", "ON", " - a failed retreat repeats the same direction.") else echoHi ("Auto-retry is ", "OFF", " - re/rw/rn/rs/ru/rd still send one retreat.") end end
function RetreatToggle () RetreatSetOn (not gEnabled) end
-- retsilent: hide/show the per-retry line. Status, conflict and help -- messages still print either way. function RetreatToggleSilent () gSilent = not gSilent SetVariable ("silent", gSilent and "1" or "0") if gSilent then echoHi ("Retry messages are ", "OFF", " - retrying quietly.") else echoHi ("Retry messages are ", "ON", " - each retry prints a line.") end end
-- retdebug: what the plugin thinks is going on. Mostly here to show whether -- GMCP is reaching us at all - the queue leans on it for everything except -- the "You retreat from the fight!" line. function RetreatDebug () echo ("Debug:") helpLine ("gmcp", gGmcp .. " room.info/char.status messages seen" .. (gGmcp == 0 and " <- NONE ARRIVING" or "")) helpLine ("room", tostring (gVnum) .. " area: " .. tostring (gZone)) helpLine ("state", tostring (gState) .. (gState == COMBAT_STATE and " (fighting)" or "")) helpLine ("queue", (#gQueue == 0) and "(empty)" or table.concat (gQueue, ", ")) helpLine ("fought", tostring (gFought) .. " (has a fight touched this chain)") helpLine ("leg", (gLegSent and "in flight" or "none") .. (gWalked and ", walking" or ", retreating") .. (gWaiting and ", held for verdict" or "") .. ", tries " .. gTries) helpLine ("age", (gLast == 0) and "-" or (os.time () - gLast) .. "s since last send") end
function RetreatHelp () echo ("Retreat, and keep retreating, in one direction.") helpLine ("re rw rn", "retreat east / west / north") helpLine ("rs ru rd", "retreat south / up / down") helpLine ("reton", "turn auto-retry on") helpLine ("retoff", "turn auto-retry off") helpLine ("ret", "toggle auto-retry") helpLine ("retsilent", "toggle the per-retry message") helpLine ("ret help", "this screen") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " Every ", CLR_HI, "", "You FAIL to retreat!", CLR_MSG, "", " sends the same direction again, as many") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " times as it takes.") -- The direction stack is deliberately undocumented here. sweep () local q = "" if #gQueue > 0 and not gWaiting then q = gWalked and (", walking " .. gQueue[1]) or (", retreating " .. gQueue[1]) end echoHi ("Currently ", gEnabled and "ON" or "OFF", q .. (gSilent and ", retry messages off." or ".")) end
-- ===================================================================== -- Trigger callback: "You FAIL to retreat!" -- ===================================================================== function RetreatFailed () if not gEnabled then return end -- This line only exists because a real fight refused a real retreat, so it -- is proof we are fighting - better proof than GMCP, and it has to be set -- before the sweep or an armed-out-of-combat direction gets dropped here. if #gQueue > 0 then gFought = true end if not queueLive () then return end local dir = gQueue[1] sendRetreat () if not gSilent then echoHi ("Retreat failed - going ", dir, " again (try " .. gTries .. ").") end end
-- ===================================================================== -- Trigger callback: "You retreat from the fight!" -- ===================================================================== -- The retreat landed. This is THE signal for a retreat leg: a nomap room -- reports no room number over GMCP, so a room change may never arrive, and -- the leg would sit at the front of the queue forever - swallowing the next -- direction you type instead of retreating with it. function RetreatLanded () if #gQueue > 0 and gLegSent then advanceQueue () end end
-- ===================================================================== -- Trigger callback: "You aren't fighting anyone." -- ===================================================================== -- The retreat found no fight, so the whole chain is void: nothing is chasing -- us, nothing landed, and leaving the direction armed only means it goes off -- in whatever fight happens next. This is the authoritative version of the -- ARM_SECS timeout - the MUD telling us straight away. function RetreatNotFighting () if #gQueue == 0 then return end local pending = #gQueue > 1 clearQueue () -- One misfired retreat explains itself; a dropped chain does not. if pending and not gSilent then echo ("Not in a fight - chain dropped.") end end
-- ===================================================================== -- Trigger callback: "You cannot retreat in that direction!" -- ===================================================================== -- There is no exit that way, so every retry would fail identically and the -- leg would never land. Drop the whole chain and say so - this one is worth -- printing even in silent mode, because it is why nothing else happens. function RetreatNoExit () if #gQueue == 0 then return end local dir = gQueue[1] clearQueue () echoHi ("No exit ", dir, " - stopped.") end
-- ===================================================================== -- Trigger callback: "Not while you are fighting!" -- ===================================================================== -- A plain move refused because something is on us. Retreat that leg instead. function RetreatBlocked () if not gEnabled then return end if not gWalked or not gLegSent then return end if not queueLive () then return end local dir = gQueue[1] sendRetreat () if not gSilent then echoHi ("Caught in a fight - retreating ", dir, " instead.") end end
-- ===================================================================== -- GMCP (telnet option 201) - advance or end the queue as the fight resolves -- ===================================================================== function OnPluginTelnetSubnegotiation (theType, data) if theType ~= 201 then return end
local message = string.match (data, "^([%w%.%-_]+)") if not message then return end message = string.lower (message)
if message == "room.info" or message == "char.status" then gGmcp = gGmcp + 1 end
-- Moved rooms: the retreat worked (or something else moved us). Whatever -- was stacked behind it is next. if message == "room.info" then local vnum = string.match (data, '"num"%s*:%s*"?(%-?%d+)"?') local zone = string.match (data, '"zone"%s*:%s*"([^"]*)"')
-- A different area means we are not where we were escaping from any -- more - death dumps us in our home city, and a recall or portal is the -- same story. Whatever was stacked up is meaningless there. if zone and gZone and zone ~= gZone then gVnum = vnum or gVnum gZone = zone if #gQueue > 0 then clearQueue () end return end if zone then gZone = zone end
if vnum and vnum ~= gVnum then gVnum = vnum -- Retreat legs do NOT land on this signal - they land on the MUD's own -- "You retreat from the fight!" line. A nomap room reports no room -- number, so waiting on a room change there leaves the leg stuck at the -- front of the queue forever. Walk legs have no success line of their -- own, so they still land here. if #gQueue > 0 and gLegSent and gWalked then advanceQueue () end end return end
if message == "char.status" then local st = tonumber (string.match (data, '"state"%s*:%s*(%d+)') or "") if not st then return end gState = st
if st == COMBAT_STATE then gEndedAt = nil if #gQueue > 0 then gFought = true end -- Still fighting after the retreat landed: the mob in the new room has -- us, which is exactly what the stacked direction was for. Go. if gWaiting and gEnabled and queueLive () then local dir = gQueue[1] sendRetreat () if not gSilent then echoHi ("Retreat landed - now going ", dir, ".") end
-- Something engaged us on a leg we were walking. A plain move will not -- get out of a fight, so redo that leg as a retreat. elseif gWalked and gEnabled and queueLive () then local dir = gQueue[1] sendRetreat () if not gSilent then echoHi ("Caught in a fight - retreating ", dir, " instead.") end end else -- Combat broke. If we had just landed, the room is empty: walk the -- next leg rather than retreating it. If we never moved at all, the -- retreat is moot - the grace below only covers the room change for -- THIS retreat arriving a beat late. if gWaiting then if gEnabled and queueLive () then walkNext () else clearQueue () end else -- Only meaningful once a fight actually had us: before that, "not -- fighting" is just the normal state of walking around. if #gQueue > 0 and gFought and not gEndedAt then gEndedAt = os.time () end sweep () end end end end
-- ===================================================================== -- Housekeeping -- ===================================================================== function OnPluginInstall () gEnabled = GetVariable ("enabled") ~= "0" gSilent = GetVariable ("silent") == "1" clearQueue () end
function OnPluginSaveState () SetVariable ("enabled", gEnabled and "1" or "0") SetVariable ("silent", gSilent and "1" or "0") end
